name: Summer Playground Camp
operator_name: City of Cranston Parks and Recreation Department
description_short: A 6-week city-run day program for Cranston residents ages 6-12, held rain or shine at four playground sites and built around field trips and activities. Campers bring their own lunch and must be picked up by 4:00pm.
